body:
Design-only scoping for qi, LO's own named Phase 2 frontend, once Phase 1's well-scoped work reached a natural pause point (remaining items are genuine source-doc ambiguities best left for founder confirmation, or larger separately-scoped projects). No code -- matches the repo's own Spec Before Implementation precedent. Real, answered question: qi's actual value-add over writing .prn directly is (1) staying in LO's own narrow base4-state value space, and (2) giving LO real named variables via a compile-time name->depth lowering pass emitting the same AST Phase 1 already produces -- zero changes to internal/parser or internal/emitter. First-draft EBNF for scalars/Let/Switch/Lambda/Call; Pattern/Match deferred to Phase 2c. Phased plan: 2a lexer -> 2b parser+lowering (verified through the same real parena-build+cc+execution pipeline) -> 2c Pattern/Match. Registered LO-QI-NORTHSTAR in golden-docs-index. commit e1dca89.

⚓ ☃
title: QI_NORTHSTAR.md -- real scoping pass for Phase 2 (qi frontend)
